'''Weiss''' is an [[ice troll]] settlement located in [[the North]], requiring partial completion of [[Making Friends with My Arm]] to access. Below the settlement are the [[salt mine]] and the [[Ghorrock Dungeon]].

==Transportation==
All methods of accessing Weiss require at least partial completion of the quest [[Making Friends with My Arm]].

Weiss has one teleport, [[icy basalt]], which teleports players near the [[herb patch]]es in the western section of town. A permanent version of the teleport can be built in a player-owned home. Players who obtain the [[frozen tablet]] from [[Duke Sucellus]] may also use the ring of shadows to teleport to the dungeon beneath the settlement.

Players can also use [[Larry]]'s boat north-east of [[Rellekka]] to sail to Weiss. Larry can be reached a number of ways, including [[fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|DKS}}, the [[Fremennik sea boots]], or the [[enchanted lyre]]. Finally, players with 80 [[Sailing]] can dock at the [[mooring point]] after completing the quest.

==History==
{{LoreSources|Making Friends with My Arm|Secrets of the North}}

The troll village of Weiss was founded during the [[Fifth Age]] by a group of powerful rogue [[ice troll]]s, led by [[Mother]]. Mother and his tribe were forced into the inhospitable tundra north after their invasion was repelled by the dwarves of [[Keldagrim]] and the [[Wise Old Man]]. There, using whatever they could find, they managed to construct their settlement, which was unknowingly placed on top of the ancient Zarosian fortress of [[Ghorrock]]. They soon discovered various [[salt]] deposits underneath the village. 

The trolls in Weiss harbored a lingering hatred of humans, due to the actions of the Wise Old Man. In year 169 of the Fifth Age, Mother sent representative [[Wolfbone]] to the [[Troll Stronghold]], prompting a human adventurer who had helped the mountain trolls to travel to Weiss. Although the human travelled with a [[My Arm|mountain troll]], they had to initially evade the inhabitants, since the ice trolls did not know that the mountain troll would be accompanied by a human. 

During negotiations, My Arm became infatuated with Mother's daughter, [[Snowflake]], but could not gain the approval of Mother. With the assistance of a troll named [[Odd Mushroom]], the four attempt to trick Mother into believing that My Arm killed the Wise Old Man. However, the plot was revealed, causing Mother to kill Odd Mushroom and attack the rest of the group. The adventurer manages to kill Mother, leading Snowflake to marry My Arm and becomes the new leader of Weiss. From then onward, the human adventurer was given access to the village. 

==Locations==
There are only two covered buildings in Weiss. One of them, located at the centre of the settlement, hosts the throne, as well as the entrance to the salt mine. There is also a small covered structure near the herb patch, hosting a bed. All other structures are open at the top, and most contain a resource, such as timber, salt, or ice wolves (which the trolls eat as food).

===Salt Mine===
The [[salt mine]] is found under the main hut. In the mine, players can mine various [[salt|salts]], which can be used to create [[fire pit]]s and [[basalt]] teleports. While [[efh]], [[te]], and [[urt salt]] are [[stack]]able, basalt is not; however, players can return upstairs and speak to Snowflake to have them converted into [[bank note]]s.

===Herb patch===
There is also a disease-free [[herb patch]] right near the icy basalt teleport location. In order to make use of it, players must first build a [[fire of nourishment]], requiring 2 [[mahogany plank]]s, 2 [[steel bar]]s, 100 [[efh salt]], 50 [[te salt]] and 150 [[urt salt]]. A [[hammer]], [[saw]] and [[tinderbox]] are required to construct the fire.

=== Ghorrock Dungeon ===
From the salt mine, players can access the [[Ghorrock Dungeon]]. Inside the dungeon is the fearsome [[Phantom Muspah]], accessible after completing [[Secrets of the North]]. Players can also enter the [[Ghorrock Prison]] from the northern part of the dungeon, allowing them to take on the menacing Duke Sucellus after completing [[Desert Treasure II]]. Both of these bosses are very high-level, and result in good profit per hour for experienced players. Players can also mine [[ancient essence]] here, requiring 75 [[Mining]].

==Trivia==
*"[[wiktionary:weiss|Weiss]]" (properly spelled as [[wiktionary:weiß|''weiß'']]) is German for white, a reference to the snow.
*Weiss was a suggestion from an ''Old School RuneScape'' player in 2016. Mod Ash announced at RuneFest 2016 to work on a troll quest, which would take place in what was then called at the time "Wiss" (also referred to as "the ugly black square above the Ice Path").
*There are several inaccessible locations found around Weiss, which can be viewed if players have an [[oculus orb]].
**South of the town itself, a [[hunter]] area can be seen filled with [[deadfall trap]]s. However, there are no [[hunter creatures]] to be seen.
**To the east, a large, abandoned, [[Zaros]]ian fortress known as [[Ghorrock]]. While players can visit Ghorrock's [[Ghorrock Dungeon|dungeon]] and [[Ghorrock Prison|prison]], the surface area of the fortress is inaccessible.
**South of the fortress, an [[Old Shrine]] can be seen, with the examine text stating "''An ancient stone, possibly used in some sort of ritual.''" This shrine is in fact the {{RSL|ritual marker}} used by the [[Mahjarrat]] in their {{RSL|Ritual of Rejuvenation}}.
